picks.name: Pier Park Stewardship
picks.description: Lend a hand caring for St. Johns' beloved Pier Park — planting, mulching, and tidying trails with Portland Parks. Free, family-friendly, and a feel-good way to start the weekend outside.

picks.name: Plaidurday Party
picks.description: It's Plaidurday — the global celebration of all things plaid — and Dixie Tavern throws the party. Dust off your flannel and come dance; the more tartan, the better. Get free cover for wearing plaid!

picks.name: Craft Chocolate Festival
picks.description: Taste your way through dozens of craft chocolate makers at Olympic Mills — bean-to-bar samples, truffles, and more. A rich, delicious weekend for your sweet tooth.

picks.name: Pandyfest Backyard Show
picks.description: A DIY backyard music show in NE Portland — intimate, grassroots, and exactly the kind of lineup that keeps Portland's underground scene alive. $20 at the gate. DM @pandyfestpdx on Instagram for location.

picks.name: Sexy Nerds Party
picks.description: White Owl's Sexy Nerds Party is a come-as-your-hottest-nerd dance night — cosplay encouraged, judgment checked at the door. Nerd is an easy costume to start getting in the Halloween spirit!

picks.name: Football Singles Mixer
picks.description: Meet Your Match hosts a football-watch singles mixer at The Garden Tavern — catch the game, meet someone new, keep it low-pressure. Free to join.

picks.name: Felted Pumpkin Workshop
picks.description: Make your own felted pumpkin with the Overcast Animation Collective at ADX Fest — a cozy, hands-on craft session and part of ADX's big weekend of maker workshops. Beginner-friendly. Part of the larger ADX-Fest happening all month!

picks.name: Stumptown Strays Costume Contest
picks.description: Dress your dog to the nines for Stumptown Strays' costume contest at The Bye and Bye — prizes, treats, and a parade of very good costumed pups, all benefiting rescue. $10 to enter a costume, free to watch.
